points: Built a hierarchical multimodal multi-agent AI platform for conversational video editing, serving approximately 1,000 daily users, using Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, MCP, and SSE; coordinating 5 specialized agents, 20+ tools, and 10+ AI workflows.
Implemented a RAG pipeline with ChromaDB to retrieve relevant video context and metadata, enabling conversational querying over users' video content.

Designed and deployed production-grade asynchronous services and REST APIs with FastAPI, including reconnectable SSE streaming, concurrent execution, structured error recovery, and persistent conversational state.

Built a distributed FastMCP tool ecosystem integrating AI agents with 20+ production tools and external services for subtitle generation, timeline editing, audio enhancement, teaser generation, and multimodal color grading.

Engineered resilient agentic workflows with LangGraph, asynchronous tool orchestration, checkpointed execution, interrupt/resume support, and long-context memory compaction across 10+ workflow graphs.
Optimized service orchestration using persistent MCP sessions, MongoDB checkpointing, and concurrent caching, achieving approximately 400 ms agent-to-frontend streaming latency.
